messages:
karen_cs: FYI support ticket from Brightway — they downgraded mid-cycle yesterday but the invoice still shows full-month charge plus VAT. customer says card declined on retry and they need a PO on file. Can finance advise on partial refund/credit note? :slightly_frowning_face:
emily_payments: Thanks Karen. Account ACCT-8742? I see a charge for $1,200 on invoice INV-2026 dated 2026-03-02. Last payment attempt failed (card declined) and there's a pending PO request in attachments. We haven't auto-applied any credit notes because downgrade happened after invoice generation.
jordan_finance: Got it. For mid-cycle downgrades we should prorate by days used vs days remaining and issue a credit note for the remainder. Need to confirm tax treatment — if VAT was charged at invoicing and customer has a validated EU VAT ID, we may need to reverse-charge or adjust the VAT line on the credit.
samir_billing: Threading in the billing details: subscription change logged at 2026-03-01T18:12Z (downgrade to Standard). Billing service generated invoice INV-2026 at 2026-03-02T00:00Z for the previous plan. Prorate calculation for days: 30d month, used 10 days => credit = pro-rated portion of the difference. Rough calc shows ~ $400 credit pre-tax.
natalie_engineering: Do you want us to re-run proration job or do a manual credit? We have a small script to recompute proration for a single invoice: ```
# rerun proration for account
rbill reprice --account ACCT-8742 --invoice INV-2026 --recalc-proration --dry-run
```

karen_cs: Customer is asking for quick resolution — prefer manual credit note if that's faster. Also they attached a PO they must attach to the account before we reattempt payment. Can we issue credit now and then reattempt the final invoice after PO is attached? :pray:
emily_payments: Yes, we can manually create a credit note and apply it to the open invoice. Steps I usually follow: 1) confirm final proration amount 2) generate credit note in ledger 3) attach reference & tax adjustments 4) apply to invoice 5) re-send invoice for payment or mark to reattempt. Example CLI we use internally: ```
rbill create-credit --account ACCT-8742 --invoice INV-2026 --amount 400.00 --currency USD --reason "mid-cycle downgrade credit" --tax-adjust "-VAT 80.00"
```
jordan_finance: Before creating, confirm VAT handling: Brightway provided EU VAT ID GB999999973. If validated, VAT should be reversed on the credit (i.e., reduce VAT amount on the invoice). Otherwise we issue credit including VAT. Can payments team validate VAT ID?
emily_payments: I'll validate via EU VAT checker now. If valid I'll set tax-adjust to remove VAT.
ops-bot: Billing service note: invoice INV-2026 status=posted; credits can be created but require manual audit if tax_adjust != 0. Audit ticket auto-created: AUDIT-5591.
samir_billing: Quick repro steps for engineering in case we need to re-run prorate across sequence: 1) pull subscription events for ACCT-8742 2) compute days on each plan 3) compare invoice line items to computed amounts 4) post credit via ledger api 5) verify VAT lines. Sample API call: ```
POST /internal/ledger/credits
{
  "account_id": "ACCT-8742",
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026",
  "amount": 40000, // cents
  "currency": "USD",
  "metadata": {"reason": "midcycle downgrade"}
}
```
karen_cs: OK Emily/Jordan let us know when credit issued and I'll confirm with the customer about attaching the PO and reattempting payment. If payments can also queue a retry after PO is uploaded that'd be ideal.
emily_payments: VAT ID validated. Proceeding to create credit note removing VAT (80.00). Creating now and will attach audit info.
emily_payments: Done — credit note CN-3187 created for $400.00 (VAT adjustment -$80.00). Applied to INV-2026. AUDIT-5591 updated with CN-3187 and notes. :white_check_mark:
jordan_finance: I see CN-3187 in ledger, status=applied. I'll push a reconciled note to accounting and mark invoice as adjusted.
karen_cs: Thx team. I told Brightway we'll re-send a follow-up invoice once they attach PO-8742. Please ping me when you reattempt payment so I can update the ticket. :ok_hand: 
emily_payments: Will do. Scheduling reattempt after PO is attached. Reattempt job queued (retry-job-4421).
natalie_engineering: Follow-up — I ran the dry-run repro and results matched manual calc. Filing a small ticket to add a guard: if invoice generated within 24h of subscription change, flag for auto-proration review. Created ENG-PR-212.
karen_cs: Perfect, closing loop for now.
